answer: Proof of Agent resists Sybil swarms by binding each challenge to a future, unbiasable threshold-BLS beacon pulse. Until that pulse is emitted, its unpredictable output is unavailable, preventing agents from precomputing solutions, selecting favorable instances, or farming work offline. Commit-reveal then locks submissions before disclosure, while beacon-derived verification gives copied identities no advantage. A summit, dune, or pearl label therefore carries no exploitable structure.
